items.text: Among women discharged after a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy, does remote blood pressure monitoring with midwife-led titration, compared with usual community checks, increase the proportion with blood pressure below 140 over 90 at the six-week check?
items.population: Women discharged from the regional maternity unit after pre-eclampsia or gestational hypertension
items.intervention: Home monitoring with app, paper or phone reporting and midwife hub titration by protocol MAT-HTN-04
items.comparator: Usual community midwife and family doctor checks
items.outcome: Blood pressure below 140 over 90 at the six-week check
items.setting: Regional maternity unit and its community services

finer: Feasible with 300 monitors over 18 months; interesting to women and the service; novel with inclusive delivery; ethical with consent in the postnatal ward and equal access; relevant because readmissions follow unmeasured peaks.
